plugin.name: enne_quicknumbers
plugin.author: Enne
plugin.purpose: easier typing of big numbers. use ?.?k$ for thousands, ?.?m$ for millions, ?.?b$ for billions

muclient.script: local num=0 function process(name, line, val) num=tonumber(val[2]) if val[3]=="k" then num=num*1000 elseif val[3]=="m" then num=num*1000000 elseif val[3]=="b" then num=num*1000000000 end-- if Execute(val[1]..num..val[4]) end-- func
